title: Service progress event
description: One line of events.jsonl in a run directory, appended while an operation runs (packages/service/worker.py EventSink). Progress only: the answer is result.json.

stage.description: The step running: start, finish, or an operation's own (import, layouts, art, preview, copy...).

status.description: A failure is never an event: it is the result's error.

message.description: What to show the designer; may be empty.

progress.description: Fraction done, when the step can say.

local_time.description: Local wall-clock time, to the second, no zone.
